[SWS_DM_01317] Realization of TransferData (0x36) in context of RequestFile-
Transfer
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04135
⌈
If a TransferData (0x36) in context of RequestFileTransfer is received, the
Diagnos-
tic Server instance
shall call (depending on the data direction read/write) the
corresponding Read or Write methods of the handler classes registered via the tem-
plate constructors of DataTransferReadSession or DataTransferWriteSession.
⌋
